cRaceSource.sourceScope: Both route variants traverse real initial route authentication before an awaited params getter barrier. Four changes are applied before the read: revoked credential, expired credential, removed device, and owner changed. Revoked/expired returns 401; removed/foreign-owner returns 404 without runIds/repos. Disabled runs are separately tested to return no queued work; nonempty runs and repos results are also asserted.
cRaceSource.executionScope: Both enclosing tests passed in this run. Four cases per route are an in-test loop, not four separately named Node tests; their assertions execute as part of the passing parent test.
